LEFT JOIN stakeholder."company" co ON co."stakeholder_id" = c."stakeholder_id" AND co."audit_status" <> 'D'
LEFT JOIN stakeholder."person" pe ON pe."stakeholder_id" = c."stakeholder_id" AND pe."audit_status" <> 'D'
WHERE cb.member_id = $1
  AND cb."audit_status" <> 'D'
GROUP BY COALESCE(co."name", pe."complete_name")
LIMIT 5;
